source_text: Lectio in initiis Exodi descensum in Aegyptum et multiplicationem continet. Quantum ad aedificationem sufficit persequimur. Haec Homiliae I clausula a semine verbi usque ad mysterium Aegypti et veri Israel. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Reading in beginnings of-Exodus descent into Egypt and multiplication contains. As-much-as to edification suffices we-pursue. These of-Homily I closing from seed of-word as-far-as to mystery of-Egypt and of-true Israel. Amen.
pass_b_english: The reading at Exodus’s opening holds the descent into Egypt and the increase. We pursue as much as edifies. This is Homily I’s close — from the word’s seed as far as the mystery of Egypt and the true Israel. Amen.
